# Issue Labels Configuration

This document describes the recommended labels for the ProofOrbitBugsAndFeatures repository.
These labels should be created in the repository settings under Issues > Labels.

## Bug-related Labels

- **bug** 🐞
  - Color: `#d73a4a` (red)
  - Description: Something isn't working

- **critical** 🚨
  - Color: `#b60205` (dark red)
  - Description: Critical bug - system crash or data loss

- **high-priority** ⬆️
  - Color: `#d93f0b` (orange-red)
  - Description: High priority issue

- **medium-priority** ➡️
  - Color: `#fbca04` (yellow)
  - Description: Medium priority issue

- **low-priority** ⬇️
  - Color: `#0e8a16` (green)
  - Description: Low priority issue

## Feature-related Labels

- **enhancement** ✨
  - Color: `#a2eeef` (light blue)
  - Description: New feature or request

- **feature-request** 💡
  - Color: `#7057ff` (purple)
  - Description: Request for new functionality

## Project Labels

- **desktop** 🖥️
  - Color: `#1d76db` (blue)
  - Description: Related to ProofOrbit desktop application

- **website** 🌐
  - Color: `#0075ca` (dark blue)
  - Description: Related to ProofOrbit website

## Status Labels

- **triage** 🔍
  - Color: `#ffffff` (white, with black border)
  - Description: Needs initial review and categorization

- **in-progress** 🚧
  - Color: `#c5def5` (pale blue)
  - Description: Currently being worked on

- **blocked** 🚫
  - Color: `#e99695` (light red)
  - Description: Blocked by dependencies or other issues

- **needs-info** ❓
  - Color: `#d876e3` (pink)
  - Description: More information needed from reporter

- **wontfix** ⛔
  - Color: `#ffffff` (white, with black border)
  - Description: Will not be fixed or implemented

- **duplicate** 🔁
  - Color: `#cfd3d7` (gray)
  - Description: Duplicate of another issue

- **invalid** ❌
  - Color: `#e4e669` (yellow-gray)
  - Description: Invalid issue or not applicable

## Quality Labels

- **good-first-issue** 👶
  - Color: `#7057ff` (purple)
  - Description: Good for newcomers

- **help-wanted** 🤝
  - Color: `#008672` (teal)
  - Description: Extra attention needed

- **documentation** 📝
  - Color: `#0075ca` (dark blue)
  - Description: Improvements or additions to documentation

- **question** ❔
  - Color: `#d876e3` (pink)
  - Description: Further information is requested

## Platform Labels

- **windows** 🪟
  - Color: `#00a2ed` (windows blue)
  - Description: Windows-specific issue

- **macos** 🍎
  - Color: `#999999` (gray)
  - Description: macOS-specific issue

- **linux** 🐧
  - Color: `#ffa500` (orange)
  - Description: Linux-specific issue

- **browser-chrome** 
  - Color: `#fbbc04` (chrome yellow)
  - Description: Chrome browser specific

- **browser-firefox** 
  - Color: `#ff7139` (firefox orange)
  - Description: Firefox browser specific

- **browser-safari** 
  - Color: `#006cff` (safari blue)
  - Description: Safari browser specific

- **browser-edge** 
  - Color: `#0078d7` (edge blue)
  - Description: Edge browser specific

## Usage Notes

1. All new bug reports should initially get the `bug` and `triage` labels
2. All new feature requests should initially get the `enhancement` and `triage` labels
3. Apply project labels (`desktop`, `website`) based on which project is affected
4. Update priority labels (`critical`, `high-priority`, etc.) during triage
5. Add platform labels as needed when bugs are platform-specific
6. Update status labels as work progresses
